WITH RECURSIVE descendants AS ( SELECT id, parent_id FROM sys_menu WHERE id = #{menuId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND delete_flag = 0
UNION SELECT m.id, m.parent_id FROM sys_menu m INNER JOIN descendants d ON m.parent_id = d.id WHERE m.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND m.delete_flag = 0 ) SELECT id FROM descendants WHERE id != #{menuId}
